doc.title: Marilyn Crispell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 21, 2022

title: Vision Festival and other venues she wants to credit
summary: She adds praise for the Outpost in Albuquerque, the Parkers' Vision Festival and Ken Pickering's Vancouver festival.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Thank you. You know could I say one more thing about the arts in this country — and I know I’m going to think of a million more things I wish I had said after this is over — but like I said there is a network of places, like the Outpost in Albuquerque, Tom Guralnick’s place. There are things happening everywhere and especially, especially important I think is what William and Patricia Parker have been doing in New York with the Vision Festival. I think that is really one of our most significant festivals, maybe our most significant festival in North America for creative music. There was also the Vancouver Jazz Festival when Ken Pickering was alive, he just brought in everyone you know, from North America, from overseas, all the interesting music he heard in the world he just brought it all in. So it’s not like nothing is happening. There are wonderful things happening it just doesn’t get enough support and there’s not enough of it, but I did want to mention the Vision Festival because I think it’s so important what they’re doing.
